name: robusto
title_zh: 20 个审计员围读一篇经济学论文
tagline_zh: 投出去之前，让数值、识别、稳健性、样本构造、多重检验各路人马轮番挑刺。每个结论都过 schema 校验。
tagline_en: Before you submit, let numerical, identification, robustness, sample, and power auditors take turns poking holes.
desc_en: Run a reproducible multi-agent audit of an academic economics paper, from a PDF or directly from its LaTeX source. Parses the manuscript deterministically, routes a parser-quality preflight plus 20 specialised auditors (numerical, identification, robustness, sample construction, power and multiple testing, data availability, devil's advocate, and more), validates every result against a schema, and
why_zh: 解析是确定性的，审计员分工明确，每个发现都带 schema 校验——不是让模型自由发挥。
why_en: Deterministic parsing, specialized auditors, schema-validated findings—it turns referee nitpicking into a rerunnable pipeline.
limit_zh: 只认学术经济学论文（PDF 或 LaTeX 源）；不覆盖非经济学实证、纯理论或政策报告。审计意见是结构化清单。
limit_en: Econ papers only (PDF or LaTeX). No non-econ empirics, pure theory, or policy reports. Outputs structured audit lists—no revised draft, no.
title_en: 20 auditors dissect one econ paper, PDF or LaTeX
